title: Quartic-over-logarithmic lower bound for rational permanent formulas
abstract: Proves that every valid rational arithmetic formula over the complex numbers computing the n-by-n permanent, for n at least 32, has at least n^4 / (192 log_2 n) variable leaves. The development derives the bound through coefficient-field transcendence degree, Jacobian minors, matching-polynomial identities, and a cyclic block decomposition.

informal.PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanent_rat: For n at least 32, every valid rational formula over the complex numbers that computes the n-by-n permanent has at least n^4 / (192 log_2 n) variable leaves.
The same quartic-over-logarithmic lower bound controls variable leaves, total leaves, and vertices, and half that bound controls internal gates.
